title: Opening an invitation unsubscribe link changes nothing: the page runs no script and the GET writes nothing
steps: S1: GET /invitations/unsubscribe/<43-char token> against the invitations unsubscribe routes with a pool that records every query.
expect: S1: 200; the page holds the POST form to the same token and an Unsubscribe button; no <script> and no .submit(); the pool received no query.
evidence: #1380: the confirmation page auto-submitted its form on load, so a link scanner that ran page scripts unsubscribed the recipient
fence: Route-level request with a recording pool; POST and RFC 8058 one-click doors are covered by the existing invitations tests
